name: Microsoft Agent Framework
summary: Microsoft Agent Framework is the open-source successor to AutoGen and Semantic Kernel, built by the same teams. It provides agents with tools and MCP clients, a batteries-included harness agent, and graph-based workflows for explicit multi-agent orchestration. Available for .NET and Python, with Go in preview.
facts: Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama and more
goodFor: Teams migrating from AutoGen or Semantic Kernel
watchOut: Docs and samples lean on Azure and Foundry
